The package() function installs only built artifacts and static configuration files into appropriate system directories, including systemd service files, module loading configuration, and default config files—standard practices for a system service on Arch Linux. All installed files are directly related to the application's functionality and follow typical packaging conventions.

No dangerous commands (e.g., curl|bash, eval, base64 decoding) are present, and there is no runtime behavior that would exfiltrate data or execute external code. The use of `backup` for configuration files is appropriate and expected. Everything in this PKGBUILD aligns with safe, reproducible, and transparent packaging practices for an AUR package.
